fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 6 months after arrival and have at least 1 blank page.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de la llegada y tener al menos 1 página en blanco.
entry.quote: To enter Thailand, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have at least 1 blank page.

entry.en: From 15 September 2026, visa-exempt entry allows a stay of up to 30 days for tourism only.
entry.es: Desde el 15 de septiembre de 2026, la entrada sin visado permite una estancia de hasta 30 días solo por turismo.
entry.quote: From 15 September 2026, if you enter Thailand under the visa exemption scheme, you can stay for up to 30 days for tourism only.

entry.en: All foreign nationals entering by air, land or sea must complete a digital arrival card online before arrival.
entry.es: Todos los extranjeros que entren por aire, tierra o mar deben completar una tarjeta digital de llegada en línea antes de llegar.
entry.quote: From 1 May 2025, all foreign nationals entering Thailand, whether by air, land or sea must complete a digital arrival card online before arrival.

entry.en: You may be asked to prove enough money (at least 10,000 baht per person or 20,000 per family) and onward or return travel.
entry.es: Pueden pedirte pruebas de fondos suficientes (al menos 10.000 baht por persona o 20.000 por familia) y de viaje de salida o regreso.
entry.quote: You may be asked to show that you meet the entry requirements. This could include proof that you have enough money for your stay (at least 10,000 Thai baht per person or 20,000 Thai baht per family) and evidence of onward or return travel.

entry.en: Overstaying your visa brings a fine of 500 baht a day up to a maximum of 20,000 baht.
entry.es: Exceder el plazo del visado conlleva una multa de 500 baht al día hasta un máximo de 20.000 baht.
entry.quote: If you overstay the period of your visa, you will get a fine of 500 Thai baht a day up to a maximum of 20,000 baht.

entry.en: It is illegal to take more than 200 cigarettes per person into Thailand.
entry.es: Es ilegal llevar a Tailandia más de 200 cigarrillos por persona.
entry.quote: It is illegal to take more than 200 cigarettes per person into Thailand.

safety.en: There are regular terrorist attacks in the 4 southernmost provinces by the border with Malaysia.
safety.es: Hay ataques terroristas regulares en las 4 provincias del extremo sur, junto a la frontera con Malasia.
safety.quote: There are regular terrorist attacks in the 4 provinces in the southern tip of Thailand by the border with Malaysia.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to within 20km of the land border with Cambodia.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje salvo el imprescindible a menos de 20 km de la frontera terrestre con Camboya.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to within 20km of the land border with Cambodia.

safety.en: Criticising the Thai monarchy is illegal, and the law can be interpreted broadly and carries a long prison sentence.
safety.es: Criticar a la monarquía tailandesa es ilegal; la ley puede interpretarse de forma amplia y conlleva una larga pena de prisión.
safety.quote:
Criticising the Thai monarchy

Criticising the Thai monarchy (‘lèse-majesté’) is illegal. The law can be interpreted broadly and carries a long prison sentence.

safety.en: It is illegal to possess or use any vape, e-cigarette, e-liquid or heat-not-burn device in Thailand.
safety.es: Es ilegal poseer o usar cualquier vapeador, cigarrillo electrónico, e-líquido o dispositivo de tabaco calentado en Tailandia.
safety.quote: It is illegal to possess or use any vape, e-cigarette, pod, e-liquid, or heat-not-burn device in Thailand.

safety.en: Thailand has a high number of road traffic accidents, particularly with motorcycles.
safety.es: Tailandia tiene un gran número de accidentes de tráfico, sobre todo con motocicletas.
safety.quote: Thailand has a high number of road traffic accidents, particularly with motorcycles.

safety.en: Drink spiking and drug-assisted sexual assault happen in tourist areas around Thailand, with male and female victims.
safety.es: El drogado de bebidas y las agresiones sexuales facilitadas por drogas ocurren en zonas turísticas de Tailandia, con víctimas de ambos sexos.
safety.quote: Drink spiking and drug-assisted sexual assault does happen in tourist areas around Thailand, with male and female victims.

health.en: All hospitals require a guarantee of payment before treating patients, so adequate health insurance is needed.
health.es: Todos los hospitales exigen una garantía de pago antes de atender a los pacientes, por lo que se necesita un seguro médico adecuado.
health.quote: All hospitals require a guarantee of payment before treating patients. Make sure you have adequate health insurance.

health.en: Tap water is usually not drinkable in Thailand outside of Bangkok.
health.es: El agua del grifo normalmente no es potable en Tailandia fuera de Bangkok.
health.quote: Tap water is usually not drinkable in Thailand outside of Bangkok.

health.en: Malaria is generally not a problem in major tourist destinations but is endemic in rural areas along the borders with Cambodia, Laos and Myanmar.
health.es: La malaria no suele ser un problema en los principales destinos turísticos, pero es endémica en zonas rurales de las fronteras con Camboya, Laos y Myanmar.
health.quote: Malaria is generally not a problem in any of the major tourist destinations, but is endemic in rural areas along the borders with Cambodia (including Ko Chang in Trat Province), Laos, and Myanmar.

health.en: Dengue fever can be encountered just about anywhere, including the most modern cities.
health.es: El dengue puede encontrarse prácticamente en cualquier lugar, incluidas las ciudades más modernas.
health.quote: dengue fever can be encountered just about anywhere, including the most modern cities.

health.en: There can be high levels of air pollution in large cities.
health.es: Puede haber altos niveles de contaminación del aire en las grandes ciudades.
health.quote: There can be high levels of air pollution in large cities.

health.en: Medication sold on the street may not be genuine or may have been stolen.
health.es: Los medicamentos vendidos en la calle pueden no ser auténticos o haber sido robados.
health.quote: Medication sold on the street may not be genuine or may have been stolen.

help.en: The emergency number is 191 for ambulance, fire and police, and the ambulance number is 1669.
help.es: El número de emergencias es el 191 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía, y el de ambulancias es el 1669.

help.en: Fire is 199, police is 191 and the tourist police is 1155.
The FCDO in London can be called for urgent help if something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Se puede llamar al FCDO en Londres para pedir ayuda urgente si le ha ocurrido algo a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote: You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

getting_in.en: The main international airports are at Bangkok (BKK) and Phuket (HKT).
getting_in.es: Los principales aeropuertos internacionales están en Bangkok (BKK) y Phuket (HKT).
getting_in.quote: The main international airports in Thailand are at Bangkok  (BKK IATA) and Phuket (HKT IATA)

getting_in.en: Bangkok has two major airports: Suvarnabhumi (BKK), the main one, and the older, smaller Don Mueang (DMK), which mainly serves low-cost carriers.
getting_in.es: Bangkok tiene dos aeropuertos principales: Suvarnabhumi (BKK), el principal, y el más antiguo y pequeño Don Mueang (DMK), que atiende sobre todo a aerolíneas de bajo coste.
getting_in.quote: Bangkok has two major airports: Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK IATA) which is the main airport and serves most full-service carriers, and the older and smaller Don Mueang International Airport (DMK IATA) which primarily serves low-cost carriers.

getting_in.en: Hat Yai, Krabi, Ko Samui and Chiang Mai also have international airports, largely restricted to flights from other Southeast Asian countries.
getting_in.es: Hat Yai, Krabi, Ko Samui y Chiang Mai también tienen aeropuertos internacionales, en gran parte limitados a vuelos de otros países del sudeste asiático.
getting_in.quote: International airports are also located at Hat Yai, Krabi, Ko Samui and Chiang Mai, though these are largely restricted to flights from other Southeast Asian countries.

getting_in.en: Land borders and crossings between Thailand and Cambodia continue to be suspended.
getting_in.es: Las fronteras y pasos terrestres entre Tailandia y Camboya siguen suspendidos.
getting_in.quote: Land borders and crossings between Thailand and Cambodia continue to be suspended.

getting_in.en: Not all land border crossings into Laos are open to foreign nationals.
getting_in.es: No todos los pasos fronterizos terrestres a Laos están abiertos a extranjeros.
getting_in.quote: Not all land border crossings into Laos are open to foreign nationals.

getting_around.en: Domestic flights are a good option for long trips like Bangkok to Phuket or Chiang Mai, with competitive fares if booked in advance.
getting_around.es: Los vuelos nacionales son una buena opción para trayectos largos como Bangkok a Phuket o Chiang Mai, con tarifas competitivas si se reserva con antelación.
getting_around.quote: Domestic flights are a good option for lengthy trips like Bangkok to Phuket or Chiang Mai, with very competitive fares on the main routes if booked in advance

getting_around.en: State Railway of Thailand has a 4,000-km network covering most of the country, from Chiang Mai to beyond the Malaysian border.
getting_around.es: El Ferrocarril Estatal de Tailandia tiene una red de 4.000 km que cubre la mayor parte del país, desde Chiang Mai hasta más allá de la frontera con Malasia.
getting_around.quote: State Railway of Thailand (SRT) has a 4,000-km network covering most of the country, from Chiang Mai in the north all the way to (and beyond) the Malaysian border in the south.

getting_around.en: Grab is the main ride hailing app and is generally available in larger cities and beach destinations.
getting_around.es: Grab es la principal aplicación de transporte con conductor y suele estar disponible en las grandes ciudades y destinos de playa.
getting_around.quote: The main ride hailing app is Grab, which took over Uber's former South-east Asian operations, including that of Thailand. Grab is generally available in larger cities and beach destinations.

getting_around.en: Metered taxis are ubiquitous in Bangkok but rare outside it and Chiang Mai, and the text says to insist on the meter.
getting_around.es: Los taxis con taxímetro abundan en Bangkok pero son raros fuera de ella y de Chiang Mai, y el texto aconseja exigir el taxímetro.
getting_around.quote: Metered taxis are ubiquitous in Bangkok and starting to become more popular in Chiang Mai, but rare elsewhere in the country. When available, they are an excellent means of transport - insist on the meter.

getting_around.en: Drivers need to carry both the 1968 version of the international driving permit and their UK driving licence.
getting_around.es: Los conductores deben llevar la versión de 1968 del permiso internacional de conducir y su licencia británica.
getting_around.quote: need to carry both the 1968 version of the international driving permit (IDP) and your UK driving licence while driving.

getting_around.en: With tuk-tuks you will often be at the mercy of the driver when it comes to pricing.
getting_around.es: Con los tuk-tuk a menudo estarás a merced del conductor en cuanto al precio.
getting_around.quote: You will often find yourself at the mercy of the tuk-tuk driver when it comes to pricing

money.en: The currency of Thailand is the baht (THB).
money.es: La moneda de Tailandia es el baht (THB).
money.quote: The currency of Thailand is the baht, denoted by the symbol "฿" (ISO code: THB)

money.en: Cards are widely accepted in restaurants, shopping malls and shops catering to tourists.
money.es: Las tarjetas se aceptan ampliamente en restaurantes, centros comerciales y tiendas orientadas al turismo.
money.quote: Cards are widely accepted in the tourist industry such as in restaurants, shopping malls and shops catering to tourists.

money.en: Some businesses add a surcharge, usually 2-3%, for paying by credit card.
money.es: Algunos negocios añaden un recargo, normalmente del 2-3%, por pagar con tarjeta de crédito.
money.quote: Some businesses add a surcharge (usually 2-3%) if you're paying by credit card

money.en: ATM withdrawals in Thailand are described as one of the most expensive in the world.
money.es: Se describe que los retiros en cajeros en Tailandia son de los más caros del mundo.
money.quote: ATM withdrawals in Thailand are one of the most expensive ones around the world

money.en: Do not tip when a service charge is applied, as this is supposed to be the tip.
money.es: No se debe dar propina cuando se aplica un cargo por servicio, ya que se supone que es la propina.
money.quote: Do not tip when a service charge is applied, as this is supposed to be the tip, applied only in luxury restaurants and hotels.

money.en: Foreign visitors, with a few exceptions, can get a 7% VAT refund on luxury goods from shops in the tourist VAT refund scheme.
money.es: Los visitantes extranjeros, con pocas excepciones, pueden obtener un reembolso del 7% del IVA en artículos de lujo de tiendas del programa.
money.quote: Foreign visitors (with a few exceptions) have the benefit to receive a 7% VAT refund on luxury goods purchased from shops that participate in the 'VAT Refund for Tourists' scheme.

etiquette.en: The head is considered the most exalted part of the body and feet the lowliest, so never touch or pat a Thai on the head.
etiquette.es: La cabeza se considera la parte más elevada del cuerpo y los pies la más baja, así que nunca toques ni des palmaditas a un tailandés en la cabeza.
etiquette.quote: The head is considered the most exalted part of the body, feet the lowliest. Never touch or pat a Thai on the head, including children.

etiquette.en: If you cross paths with a monk in public, lower your head a little and greet them with the wai gesture.
etiquette.es: Si te cruzas con un monje en público, baja un poco la cabeza y salúdalo con el gesto del wai.
etiquette.quote: If you cross paths with a monk in public, lower your head a little and greet them with the 'wai' gesture.

etiquette.en: Do not say or do anything that can be misconstrued as irreverence or disrespect towards the Royal Family.
etiquette.es: No digas ni hagas nada que pueda interpretarse como irreverencia o falta de respeto hacia la Familia Real.
etiquette.quote: Do not say or do anything that can be misconstrued as irreverence or disrespect towards the Royal Family.

etiquette.en: It is customary to use honorifics with people you are unfamiliar with.
etiquette.es: Es costumbre usar títulos honoríficos con personas que no conoces.
etiquette.quote: it is customary to use honorifics with people you are unfamiliar with.

etiquette.en: Public displays of affection are rarely seen, even handholding by married couples, and are generally considered distasteful.
etiquette.es: Las muestras públicas de afecto rara vez se ven, incluso entre parejas casadas, y suelen considerarse de mal gusto.
etiquette.quote: Public displays of affection are rarely seen, even handholding by married couples, and are generally considered to be distasteful

etiquette.en: Thais are indirect communicators who need to save face and normally avoid saying anything judgemental or critical to people.
etiquette.es: Los tailandeses se comunican de forma indirecta, necesitan salvar las apariencias y normalmente evitan decir algo crítico o enjuiciador.
etiquette.quote: Thais are indirect communicators and they are tempered by the need to "save face" — much like their neighbours — and will normally avoid saying anything construed as judgemental or critical to people.

connectivity.en: Prepaid SIM cards can be bought in any convenience store from as little as 50 baht, and you must provide passport details.
connectivity.es: Las tarjetas SIM de prepago se venden en cualquier tienda de conveniencia desde 50 baht, y hay que dar los datos del pasaporte.
connectivity.quote: Prepaid SIM cards can be bought in any convenience store for as little as 50 baht, and you can charge up as you go. You must provide your passport details when buying a SIM card.

connectivity.en: Coverage is very good throughout the country, with all cities and tourist destinations well covered.
connectivity.es: La cobertura es muy buena en todo el país, con todas las ciudades y destinos turísticos bien cubiertos.
connectivity.quote: Coverage is very good throughout the country, all cities and tourist destinations (including resort islands) are well covered.

connectivity.en: Counters at Bangkok airport can register your passport and activate service 24/7, and speak English.
connectivity.es: Los mostradores del aeropuerto de Bangkok pueden registrar tu pasaporte y activar el servicio las 24 horas, y hablan inglés.
connectivity.quote: the counters at Bangkok airport can register your passport and activate service 24/7, and speak English as well.

connectivity.en: Wi-Fi is commonly available in accommodations, cafes and restaurants serving Westerners.
connectivity.es: El wifi suele estar disponible en alojamientos, cafés y restaurantes que atienden a occidentales.
connectivity.quote: Wi-Fi is commonly available in accommodations, cafes and restaurants serving Westerners.

connectivity.en: The Thai government actively censors Internet access.
connectivity.es: El gobierno tailandés censura activamente el acceso a Internet.
connectivity.quote: The Thai government actively censors Internet access.

connectivity.en: WhatsApp is not popular in Thailand, and most Thais instead use the messaging app LINE.
connectivity.es: WhatsApp no es popular en Tailandia y la mayoría usa en su lugar la aplicación LINE.
connectivity.quote: WhatsApp is not popular in Thailand, and most Thais instead use the Japanese messaging app LINE.

phrases.quote: "Sawatdee" (meaning hello) is pronounced just as it reads: sa-wat-dee.
